paragraphs: Rabbi Yohanan of Shitna. In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 187b, Rabbi Yitzhak reports in his name.

notes.text: The frozen heading has שטנה; the earlier heading audit read שבתה. The locator קפז: is retained pending an edition check.

Hyman’s printed heading (vol. II, p. 686) appears to read דמן שבתה, while the supplied Hebrew reads דמן שטנה. The Buber edition of Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, folio 187b, does have Rabbi Yitzhak reporting in the name of Rabbi Yohanan of Shitna (דמן שטנה). It is the passage about the keen-sighted bird and the sukkah of Sodom. The modern digital edition consulted gives בן שטנה. These readings do not establish a location or a father’s name.
